item.tib: khro mchog 'dus pa sde brgyad 'byung po spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las sngon 'gro nor bu'i chu gter
item.coloph: kho bo phyogs med kyi rnal 'byor ba gtsug phud rnam rgyal du 'bod pa mkha' 'gro'i gsang lung gi gsang bdag ye shes mgon po zhes bya ba bdag gis gtan la phab pa 'di yis 'gro rnams bon nyid kyi dbyings su 'khrid pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
